pro_apoptosis_genes <- c("Fas", "Tnf", "Tradd", "Fadd", "Apaf1", "Igfbp3", "Casp2", "Casp9", "Casp10", "Aifm1", "Diablo", "Cycs", "Ctsd", "Trp53", "Atg5", "Anxa1", "Pik3ca", "Ano6", "Foxo1",  Bax", "Bak1", "Bid", "Bcl2l11", "Bmf", "Bik", "Bad", "Bbc3", "Pmaip1", "Hrk", "Casp3", "Casp6", "Casp7", "Casp8")
DotPlot(all_merged_harmony_cluster_v2_PrepSCT_12sample_old_res0.5, features = pro_apoptosis_genes, 
        idents = c("Mesenchymal cells-1", "Mesenchymal cells-2", "Mesenchymal cells-3", "MD", "Non_MD", "Perivascular cells"),
